say.en: Physio Nexus Academy (PNA) is Pakistan's online physiotherapy academy: free step-by-step lessons, 3D practice patients, a clinical skills lab, manual therapy techniques, guided home rehab, a daily challenge, books and hands-on CPD workshops — in English and Roman Urdu.
say.ur: Physio Nexus Academy (PNA) Pakistan ki online physiotherapy academy hai: free step-by-step lessons, 3D practice patients, clinical skills lab, manual therapy, ghar par guided rehab, daily challenge, books aur hands-on CPD workshops — English aur Roman Urdu dono mein.

say.en: Free step-by-step physiotherapy lessons with analogies, clinical use, quick checks and flashcards — in English or Roman Urdu.
say.ur: PNA Teacher mushkil concepts ko ek ek chhote qadam mein samjhata hai — analogy, clinical use, checks aur flashcards ke saath, English ya Roman Urdu mein.

say.en: Practise manual muscle testing, goniometry, neuro exam, balance, posture and more — with 3D demonstrations, quizzes and OSCE stations.
say.ur: Clinical Skills Lab mein aap MMT, goniometry, neuro exam, balance aur posture jaisi skills 3D demonstrations, quizzes aur OSCE stations ke saath practice karte hain.

say.en: Examine a realistic 3D patient — history, positioning, goniometry, MMT, reflexes, sensation, palpation and special tests — then diagnose and get an OSCE-style score.
say.ur: Virtual Patient mein aap asli patient ki tarah 3D patient ko examine karte hain — history se special tests tak — phir diagnosis karte hain aur OSCE-style score paate hain.

say.en: RehabVerse is guided rehab at home: your physiotherapist reviews your assessment and approves an exercise programme, and every exercise is shown by a 3D virtual physio guide, in English or Roman Urdu.
say.ur: RehabVerse ghar par guided rehab hai: aap ka physiotherapist aap ka assessment dekh kar exercise programme approve karta hai, aur har exercise 3D virtual physio guide dikhata hai — English ya Roman Urdu mein.

label.en: Open PNA RehabVerse — guided 3D home rehab
label.ur: PNA RehabVerse — guided 3D home rehab kholein

say.en: 35 manual therapy techniques with hand placement, dosage, contraindications and safety, each taught step by step with PNA Teacher.
say.ur: Manual Therapy mein 35 techniques hain — hand placement, dosage, contraindications aur safety ke saath — har ek PNA Teacher ke saath qadam ba qadam.

say.en: 48 conditions by body area, each at three depths (quick guide, clinical plan, expert detail) with a stage-by-stage treatment plan.
say.ur: Conditions & Treatment Guide mein 48 conditions hain — body area ke hisaab se — har ek teen depth par (quick, clinical, expert) aur stage-by-stage treatment plan ke saath.

say.en: Real, reasoned physiotherapy cases to work through step by step — history, findings, differentials and a plan.
say.ur: Case Lab mein asli-style physiotherapy cases hain jin par aap qadam ba qadam reasoning karte hain — history, findings, differentials aur plan.

say.en: Five timed clinical questions every day. Score points, learn from every explanation and climb the public leaderboard.
say.ur: Daily Clinical Challenge mein rozana 5 timed clinical sawal hote hain. Points kamayein, har explanation se seekhein aur public leaderboard par upar jayein.

say.en: Free weekly leagues for signed-in students: earn XP from lessons, Skills Lab levels, Virtual Patient cases and the Daily Clinical Challenge, compete with up to 30 students at your tier, and move up (top 30 %) or down (bottom 20 %) across seven tiers from Bronze to Diamond every Sunday midnight Pakistan time.
say.ur: Weekly Leagues mein signed-in students har hafte XP kamate hain — lessons, Skills Lab, Virtual Patient aur Daily Challenge se — apni tier ke 30 tak students se muqabla karte hain, aur har Itwar raat Bronze se Diamond tak 7 tiers mein upar (top 30 %) ya neeche (bottom 20 %) jate hain.

say.en: Printed physiotherapy books by Dr. Sajjad Raza PT — order online and get an Order ID and a delivery estimate.
say.ur: Dr. Sajjad Raza PT ki printed physiotherapy books — online order karein aur Order ID aur delivery estimate payein.

label.en: Open Books by Dr. Sajjad Raza PT
label.ur: Books by Dr. Sajjad Raza PT kholein

say.en: Hands-on CPD workshops across Pakistan with verifiable certificates. PNA is an approved CPD provider (#791052).
say.ur: Pakistan bhar mein hands-on CPD workshops — verifiable certificates ke saath. PNA ek approved CPD provider hai (#791052).

say.en: A free student account saves everything you finish — lessons, skills, virtual patients and daily challenges — to your own private record, and shows your streak, progress and plain-language insights on any device. You can download or delete your record at any time.
say.ur: Free student account aap ki har activity — lessons, skills, virtual patients aur daily challenges — aap ke apne private record mein save karta hai, aur kisi bhi device par aap ka streak, progress aur insights dikhata hai.

label.en: Open My PNA — your personal learning record
label.ur: My PNA — your personal learning record kholein
